evidence.title: A new, modern UI component library built on top of Base UI - coss ui
GitHub - cosscom/coss: coss.com/ui is the official design system of Cal.com

name: coss ui
summary: Copy-paste React component library built on Base UI and Tailwind CSS, with 53 primitives, particles and atoms.
description: coss ui is a copy-paste component library for React apps: accessible primitives built from Base UI and styled with Tailwind CSS v4, plus pre-assembled particles (auth forms, tables, date pickers) and atoms that connect UI to APIs. Components are added with the shadcn CLI or by copying the source code, and the docs cover styling tokens, fonts, hooks and migration from Radix UI and shadcn/ui.
contains: 53 primitives built on Base UI and styled with Tailwind CSS v4
510 particles: pre-assembled patterns like auth forms, tables and date pickers
atoms: API-backed versions of particles (auth flows, scheduling)
components added with the shadcn CLI or by copying the source
design tokens as CSS variables, plus optional Inter and Geist Mono fonts
llms.txt, copy-markdown docs and Agent Skills (npx skills add cosscom/coss)
migration guide from Radix UI and shadcn/ui; 69 docs pages
repo 10.7k stars; apps/ui MIT, rest of the repo AGPL-3.0
